set.rule: 둘 이상의 짝을 셀 때는 pairs로 쓰고, of 뒤에는 복수 명사(socks)를 써요.

cz.st: I have a ___ friends in Busan.

patches.why: 'a lot friends' may be read as acceptable informal; 'a several friends' is clearly wrong.
'a lot time left' is colloquially heard; 'a several time left' is clearly wrong.

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
